# Asset Atlas (generated by `tools/asset_atlas.py`)

A lookup table for every little asset in `assets/`, mapping each one to
its grid coordinates so the engine (and an LLM driving it) knows exactly
where to go for, e.g., the tree tile.

**Regenerate:** `make atlas`   **Verify:** `make atlas-check`

Machine-readable master catalog: `assets/atlas.json`.
C API: `src/gfx/asset_atlas.h` -> `asset_atlas_get(AssetId, AssetAtlasEntry*)`
returns `{ source, size, col, row, colors, icon_uid, icon_pal }`.

| `desolate_landscape.png` | 128x24 | 16x3 | 8 | canonical | 48 cells |
| `intrepid.png` | 128x48 | 16x6 | 8 | canonical | 96 cells |
| `equipment_8x8.png` | 298x163 | 33x18 | 9 | per-tile CGB | 594 cells |
| `symbols_8x8.png` | 469x190 | 52x21 | 9 | per-tile CGB | 1092 cells |

`player_demo_preview_16x.png` is a 16x upscaled preview of the player
tile, not a source sheet.

### Font glyphs (`ASSET_GLYPH(c)` maps an ASCII char to its id)

| Range | Sheet | Grid | Glyph index |
|-------|-------|------|-------------|
| `ASSET_GLYPH_00`..`ASSET_GLYPH_5F` | `intrepid.png` | 16x6 | `col = (ascii-32) % 16`, `row = (ascii-32) / 16` |

The font is also baked into `g_intrepid_font_tiles` (tile index = ascii - 32).

### Icon sheets: coordinate ids

Every *content* cell of the two 9px-stride sheets is addressable by a
stable coordinate id (also an `AssetId`):

- `ASSET_EQUIP_C00_R00` ... `ASSET_EQUIP_C32_R17` (`equipment_8x8.png`, 194 content cells)
- `ASSET_EQUIP_C00_R00` ... `ASSET_EQUIP_C51_R20` (`symbols_8x8.png`, 364 content cells)
- `ASSET_SYM_C00_R00` ... `ASSET_SYM_C51_R20` (`symbols_8x8.png`, 364 content cells)

The JSON `icons[].cells` maps every coord id to `{col, row, unique_tile, palette, colors}`.

CGB palette per unique tile is quantized to <= 4 shades (see `asset_atlas_icon_palettes.inc`).

## ROM layout

- `g_asset_atlas_entries[]` : bank **5** (`asset_atlas_entries.inc`)
- `g_asset_icon_palettes[]`  : bank **5** (`asset_atlas_icon_palettes.inc`)
- `g_asset_icon_tiles[]`     : bank **6** (`asset_atlas_icons.inc`)
